items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: In fact, Piro and all of them, T.O., were right in the Seventh Ward, as we call it.

ctx.x: So Louis mentioned him a few times, several times. That's right. So your father lived right around, and you lived right around the corner from him.
We lived right around the corner from Mr. Moret. My grandfather lived right opposite Manuel Perez. In fact, Piro and all of them, T.O., were right in the Seventh Ward, as we call it.
You remember, were you still in New Orleans when Mr. Moret died? I don't know anything about him.
